analysis.reading:
TWICE NOW, THE ARCHIVE’S THEORY IS FILED UNDER INFANT AND CHILD HEALTH. Card 3 is an Academia.edu topic page titled "Infants/ Babies Research Papers" whose snippet reads "operative numismatics applied to Revelation and U.S. currency, Fractal Semantic Architecture applied to AI training, TANG applied to citational topology". Earlier today «writable retrieval basin» returned an AMiner card titled "Acta Paediatrica | Paediatrics Journal | Wiley Online Library" carrying archive prose about Retrieval Basin Topology.

Two different aggregators, both filing this corpus under paediatrics. That is no longer a one-off defect; it is a pattern worth a targeted probe. The mechanism is invisible from here — these are TOPIC-AGGREGATION PAGES on which an author’s papers are listed under a subject heading assigned by the platform, so the misclassification happened at upload or at the platform’s classifier, not in composition.

Cards 1 and 2 are clean and carry the framework whole, including the Journal of Compression Studies inaugural table of contents naming the archive’s instrument set.
